title: Write fuzz target for article ingress validation
description:
Write a cargo-fuzz target (fuzz/fuzz_targets/validate_ingress.rs) that passes arbitrary bytes as article input to validate_article_ingress(). Objective: no panics under any input. Artifact: fuzz/fuzz_targets/validate_ingress.rs, fuzz/Cargo.toml.

Acceptance criteria: fuzz target compiles with cargo-fuzz; no panics found in 1 million iterations; any panic is a P0 bug filed immediately; findings documented in fuzz/FINDINGS.md
